post.description: Fetch one page of observations for a GHO indicator, filtered by spatial type (COUNTRY, REGION, WORLDBANKINCOMEGROUP, GLOBAL), ISO3/region codes, year range and Dim1/Dim2/Dim3 codes (sex, age group, ...). Each record keeps the source Id, numeric value with low/high bounds as decimal strings, the display string, comments, data source and modification date; source_updated_at is the indicator's newest modification date. Unknown indicator codes fail with not_found.

provider.summary: Official provider example; checked against AIsa request constraints

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page of the same filters and page_size.

dim1.description: Dim1 value codes, e.g. SEX_FMLE or AGEGROUP_YEARS0-4.

indicator_code.description: GHO indicator code, e.g. WHOSIS_000001 (life expectancy at birth) or MDG_0000000001 (infant mortality rate). Pattern: ^[A-Za-z0-9_.+-]{1,64}$.

page_size.description:
Rows per page; the GHO server caps $top at 1000.

Provider reference: minimum 1; maximum 1000; default 100.

spatial_dim_type.description:
Restrict to one spatial level. Omit for all levels; spatial_dim_type on each record says which.

Provider reference: allowed values ["COUNTRY", "REGION", "WORLDBANKINCOMEGROUP", "GLOBAL", "null"].

spatial_dims.description: ISO3 country codes (BRA), WHO region codes (AFR), income-group codes (WB_HI) or GLOBAL.

time_from.description:
Inclusive first year (TimeDim ge).

Provider reference: minimum 1000; maximum 9999.

time_to.description:
Inclusive last year (TimeDim le).

Provider reference: minimum 1000; maximum 9999.

license.attribution: Source: World Health Organization, Global Health Observatory (https://www.who.int/data/gho). Licence: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO.
license.name: CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 IGO
